requirements.description: Compustat firm-years in the 1972–1999 sample plus historical/forward earnings, book-value, price and fiscal-year inputs required by the selected Basu timeliness fits. For origins t=1972–1999, the historical j=4 outcome uses earnings from t−4 through t and price at t−5 (1967); a conservative extra fiscal-year envelope permits calendar alignment around the year-end price date (1966). The forward k=3 horizon uses earnings through t+3 and a four-month post-fiscal-year endpoint, through 2003. The full 45,664 count is not the per-year cross-section N.
